release_notes: Build 101 adds website SEO publishing controls directly to the desktop Website manager.
Select any website quiz and choose Edit SEO to manage its search title, meta description, social title and social description.
The editor includes a Google-style search preview, a Factburst social-card preview, character guidance and duplicate-title warnings.
Every quiz gets useful SEO defaults automatically even when no custom metadata has been saved yet.
Custom SEO metadata is stored in the shared Cloudflare quiz database and survives later scheduled syncs or manual resyncs.
Published quiz slugs are shown as clean factburstquiz.com/quiz/... URLs and remain locked after publication so existing links, comments, tracking and analytics are not split.
Social previews continue to use the generated 1200x630 Factburst PNG, with the saved social title feeding the card artwork and Open Graph/Twitter copy.
The SEO administration endpoint uses the existing private Link Tracker authentication; no second API key or public website admin page is required.
Website quiz scoring, player sizing, account behavior, publishing schedules and existing visibility controls are unchanged.
